title: introduce-credential-composer-and-slim-stream-facade-cross-sdk
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Teams reported friction wiring multiple credential sources (env, KMS-backed secrets, delegated tokens) into SDK session lifecycles and inconsistent streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Motivation: simplify credential composition, make SDKs share a single small surface for pull/generator-style streams, and avoid divergent ad-hoc shims that increase cognitive load. Changes: add a lightweight CredentialComposer interface that composes ordered credential providers with precedence rules, cache hints, and proactive prime hooks; introduce a SlimStreamFacade that normalizes pull-generator and async-iterator ergonomics across languages (Session.prime API to warm credentials and optional resume tokens); implement language-specific adapters in python/ts/go under sdk/{python,typescript,go}/session to preserve idiomatic usage while achieving parity; add deprecation shims that map legacy Session.prefetch calls to Session.prime with logging for two release cycles; wire credential telemetry hooks and new retry presets that bias early-auth retries differently from request-level retries to avoid double-retries during auth window failures; update samples and E2E tests and bump SDK versions (py v1.34.0, ts v1.28.0, go v1.8.3). Backwards compatibility: behavioral-preserving for most users; a non-breaking rename is offered via deprecation shims; internal telemetry field names changed (telemetry.auth.strategy) and documented. Testing: unit tests added in all three SDKs, integration tests against a local auth-proxy, cross-language smoke harness, and perf runs showing median stream connect latency unchanged and 12% reduction in duplicate auth attempts under high concurrency. Rollout: merged behind feature flag and will be ramped for paid tenants first.

review_comments: Simon Huang: Love the Composer abstraction; please ensure provider ordering is stable across runs and add deterministic fallback tests.
Author (Asha Patel): added deterministic ordering tests and a tie-breaker based on provider registration order.
Leah Ortiz: TS ergonomic surface looks good but prefer rename of 'prime' param 'resumeToken' -> 'checkpoint' for clarity.
Author (Asha Patel): updated TS adapter and docs to use 'checkpoint' and left compatibility alias 'resumeToken' for one release.
Tomás Rivera: Go adapter needs clearer ownership rules for goroutine lifetimes in the SlimStreamFacade; potential leak found.
Author (Asha Patel): revised Go adapter to use context cancellation and added a goroutine leak detector test.
release_notes: Introduce CredentialComposer to compose multiple credential sources with precedence and prime hooks.
Add SlimStreamFacade to harmonize pull/generator stream ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go.
Session.prefetch deprecated in favor of Session.prime; prefetch is auto-mapped for two release cycles with a warning.
SDK version bumps: python 1.34.0, typescript 1.28.0, go 1.8.3.
Telemetry: new field telemetry.auth.strategy to reflect composer decisioning.
changelog_entry: 2026-03-05: credential composer and slim stream facade rolled out; Session.prime introduced (Session.prefetch deprecated). See docs/sdk/migration-auth-composer.md for migration steps.
notes: This PR focuses on ergonomics and parity rather than model-serving behavior. The feature is behind a flag and will be enabled gradually; please coordinate with SRE for tenant ramp.
